headline: Israel bars U.S. citizens over criticism and ties to Palestinian activists, lawyers say
context: Travelers from the U.S. and other nations are denied entry to Israel after interrogations about their links to Palestinians, plans to visit the occupied West Bank and opinions of Israel, lawyers say.
